<b>Grass Doll</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It is a doll belonging to [[Gilly]] that was stolen from her.

== Use ==
Grass Doll can be turned in at [[Bellhart]] to complete the <i>[[The Hidden Hunter]]</i> [[wish]], which grants a [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|Mask Shard]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Frey 01.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Frey 02.png!Wishwall in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Grass Doll can be picked up after defeating [[Gurr the Outcast]] in [[Act 3]], who is found after accepting the wish [[The Hidden Hunter]].
